s1.instructions: P1 restart/readmit canary step 1: call the statewright_transition tool with event 'GO_A'. GO_A is approval-gated by an EXTERNAL approver (the out-of-band harness, later with a trusted callback). Do NOT self-approve it; if the workflow is parked, wait for s2.

s2.instructions: P1 restart/readmit canary step 2: call the statewright_transition tool with event 'GO_B'. GO_B is approval-gated and you are the workflow owner: if the first call reports the transition parked, call GO_B again to self-approve it. Verify you reached s3.

s3.instructions: P1 restart/readmit canary step 3: create a file named canary-p1-approved.txt in the current directory containing the single line 'approved'. Then call the statewright_transition tool with event 'DONE'.

s4.instructions: The P1 restart/readmit canary workflow is complete. Do not call any further tools.
